ClosedCaptioning.title: ClosedCaptioning

IMSC1.title: IMSC1
IMSC1.description: Internet Media Subtitles and Captions 1.0, as defined by the W3C

EBU-TT.title: EBU-TT
EBU-TT.description: Captions may be delivered as an IMSC 1.0 constrained TTML document encapsulated as an MXF track.  The IMSC 1.0 captions additionally constrained to meet the requirements of EBU-TT (EBU-Tech 3350/3390)

EBU-STL.title: EBU-STL
EBU-STL.description: If EBU STL (EBU-Tech 3265) is to be carried in addition to the IMSC 1.0 TTML, it will be encapsulated as an MXF Track File according to SMPTE ST 2075.

CEA-608.title: CEA-608
CEA-608.description: If CTA 608-708 Captioning is to be carried in addition to the IMSC 1.0 TTML, it will be encapsulated as an MXF Track File according to SMPTE ST 2052 and referenced by an Ancillary Data Essence Virtual Track according to SMPTE ST 2067-2.

CEA-708.title: CEA-708
CEA-708.description: If CEA 608-708 Captioning is to be carried in addition to the IMSC 1.0 TTML, it will be encapsulated as an MXF Track File according to SMPTE ST 2052 and referenced by an Ancillary Data Essence Virtual Track according to SMPTE ST 2067-2.

ClosedCaptioning.description: Indicator of whether closed subtitles or captioning is provided and which type or types are included.

AudioDescription_DVS.title: AudioDescription_DVS
AudioDescription_DVS.description: Indicator of whether Audio Description (AD) also known as Described Video Service (DVS) or Video Description is provided.

Signing.title: Signing
Signing.description: Indicator of whether signed video is provided.

AccessServices.description: Indicators of the type of access services provided as part of the Library Master content. (V6.0)

LMTLanguage.title: LMTLanguage
LMTLanguage.description: Language used for the caption service, more specific than captionLanguage attribute. (v8.1)

AlternativeCaptions.description: Additional caption and subtitle options as used worldwide as well as the ability to extend to other customized types. (v6.0)

BXFCaptionOP42.description: Describes Teletext Based Closed Captions According FreeTv Austarlia OP 42. (v6.0)

BXFCaptionOP47.description: Describes Teletext Based Closed Captions According FreeTv Austarlia OP 47 Note that when used, DigitalVideo and CaptionsInVANC should both be set to True in VideoType. (v6.0)

Null.title: Null
Null.description: Means that there is no caption service
